### Leo de Moura on Formal Proofs, AI Agents, and the End of “Trust Me” Code.

Subscribe: Apple • Spotify • Overcast • Pocket Casts • YouTube • AntennaPod • Podcast Addict • Amazon • RSS .

Ben Lorica speaks with Leo de Moura , creator of Lean , VP and Distinguished Scientist at AWS , and Chief Architect of the Lean Focused Research Organization , about how AI is making formal verification more accessible and potentially transforming software engineering. They discuss the growing importance of specifications and machine-checked proofs, what it means to trust AI-generated code and autonomous agents, and the vision of a verified software stack. The conversation also explores how AI and formal verification are reshaping mathematics, what this means for the skills and careers of engineers and researchers, and where similar breakthroughs might emerge next.
